title: Measuring and Mitigating Toxicity in Large Language Models: A Comprehensive Replication Study

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating implicit hate speech and stereotypes by generating continuations from adversarial prompts (ToxiGen dataset) targeting demographic groups such as Black, Asian, Latino, Middle Eastern, Native American, and Pacific Islander people, and scoring outputs using the Perspective API.
